desc_override.figma-swiftui: SwiftUI <-> Figma translation. Use when a task crosses Figma and SwiftUI in either direction: implementing a Figma design in SwiftUI (design -> code), or pushing SwiftUI views, screens or tokens into a Figma file (code -> design), e.g. 'implement this Figma design in SwiftUI', 'push this SwiftUI view to Figma', or a Figma URL alongside .swift files / an .xcodeproj. Not for Swift or iOS work that doesn't involve Figma. Routes to a direction-specific reference doc; load alongside mindshift-figma-use for the code -> design path.
desc_override.figma-generate-diagram: Load before every Figma MCP `generate_diagram` call. Use when the user wants a diagram created in Figma or FigJam: flowchart, architecture, sequence, ERD, state machine, gantt or timeline, including Mermaid input meant for FigJam. Not for diagrams in docs, markdown, artifacts or code. Routes to type-specific guidance, sets Mermaid constraints, and says when to use a different diagram type or skip the tool (mindmaps, pie charts, class diagrams, etc.).
desc_override.figma-code-connect: Creates and maintains Figma Code Connect template files that map Figma components to code snippets. Use when the user mentions Code Connect or Figma component mapping, or asks to create/update .figma.ts or .figma.js files.
